If these details were invented in the Middle Ages, they would constitute an uncanny anticipation of discoveries not made until 1947. The counter-argument — that such material could have been extrapolated from canonical references to the Essenes — explains some but not all of the parallels. The calendrical specificity and the angelic oath formulas have no canonical source. It remains a plausible hypothesis that the Slavonic *War* descends from a branch of the tradition that carried sectarian memory of the Word as law and book.
